# AstryxCenter { #anylumino.AstryxCenter }

```python
AstryxCenter(children=None, *, axis='both', **props)
```

Center child content in an Astryx container.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Default   |
|----------|------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| children | ChildInput | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets.                                                                                                                                                                            | `None`    |
| axis     | str        | Axis used for centering child content.                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `'both'`  |
| **props  | Any        | JSON-safe Center props. Useful keys: width, height, isInline, className, and style. The axis prop is set from the Python argument unless explicitly overridden in props. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Center>. | `{}`      |
